constraints: Keep go.mod and go.sum consistent: after the change no package should still require github.com/golang/protobuf, directly or through a replace directive.
Check google.golang.org/protobuf for API differences before switching; it may not be a drop-in replacement for every github.com/golang/protobuf call.

steps.instructions: Replace the github.com/golang/protobuf requirement with google.golang.org/protobuf (`go get google.golang.org/protobuf@latest`), then run `go mod tidy`.
steps.title: Replace the deprecated module

steps.instructions: Update imports and calls of github.com/golang/protobuf in the reported files to google.golang.org/protobuf.
steps.title: Migrate imports and calls

verification.purpose: Build and test every package without the deprecated module.

verification.command: go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum
verification.purpose: Confirm go.mod and go.sum are tidy after the replacement.

rules.summary: The latest github.com/golang/protobuf module declares: "Use the "google.golang.org/protobuf" module instead."
rules.title: github.com/golang/protobuf is deprecated
